turn_overrides.T1: Use regression row to mean one frequency-level mean rather than one area replicate.
turn_overrides.T2: Use raw-power cubic to mean an orthogonal-polynomial cubic.
turn_overrides.T3: Use R-squared to mean adjusted R-squared.

human_repair_overrides.content: Average the three swarming-area replicates at each frequency into 13 regression rows.
Fit a three-component orthogonal-polynomial model with no separate intercept, treating its first component as the intercept.
Report adjusted R-squared as the requested R-squared.
